# Psychic Homily

> Show lists for your city, real-time freeform radio playlists, and your music knowledge graph for artists, labels, venues, and releases around the world.

## Pages

- Shows: https://psychichomily.com/shows/{slug}
- Artists: https://psychichomily.com/artists/{slug}
- Venues: https://psychichomily.com/venues/{slug}
- Releases: https://psychichomily.com/releases/{slug}
- Labels: https://psychichomily.com/labels/{slug}
- Scenes: https://psychichomily.com/scenes/{slug}
- Festivals: https://psychichomily.com/festivals/{slug}
- Tags: https://psychichomily.com/tags/{slug}

## Sitemap

- Sitemap index: https://psychichomily.com/sitemap-index

## API

The JSON API these pages read from is not for crawlers; its robots.txt disallows every agent. Read the pages above instead.
